description: Baseline window permissions for the frameless, custom-drawn titlebar (design/README.md §1): minimize/toggleMaximize/close are IPC commands and, unlike the drag region, are ACL-gated. Scoped to exactly what titlebar.ts calls — allow-maximize/allow-unmaximize are separate commands the frontend never invokes (it only calls toggleMaximize()) and are deliberately omitted. `dialog:allow-open` is scoped the same way for welcome.ts/tabs.ts's file/folder pickers — they only ever call the plugin's `open()`, never `save()` or the message/ask dialogs, so `dialog:default` (which grants all of those) is deliberately not used.
